name: Balor
summary: A towering demon of flame that lashes with a flaming whip and explodes when it dies.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.text: The balor explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the balor. *Failure:* {dmg:9d6:fire} plus {dmg:9d6:force}. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the balor's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the balor takes {dmg:3d8:fire}.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The balor has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The balor makes one Flame Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack.

actions.name: Flame Whip
actions.onHit: If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the balor pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.onHit: and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the balor's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.text: The balor teleports itself or a willing demon within 10 feet of itself up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the balor can see.
